isolation.notes: Redirect-only app-host handoff captured as start/final URL plus result per assignment.

assertions.title: Guest auth is governed by the guest system

steps.observed: Guest-branded role-selection page rendered at http://localhost:3000/auth

steps.expected: Guest sign-in route keeps guest framing
steps.observed: Navigated to http://localhost:3000/auth/signin with guest shell and passwordless email form

evidence.network: Document requests for /auth and /auth/signin returned rendered guest auth pages

assertions.title: Redirect targets are sanitized to validated internal paths

steps.expected: Valid internal redirect intent is preserved
Unsafe redirect target is sanitized or replaced with safe default

evidence.network: Direct document loads showed unsafe redirectedFrom query surviving on the guest sign-in URL

assertions.issues: Unsafe external redirectedFrom query was not sanitized on the rendered guest sign-in URL.

assertions.title: Role selection clearly separates guest and owner journeys

steps.expected: Distinct guest and owner paths are visible
steps.observed: Page exposed separate 'Sign in as Guest', 'Sign in as Owner', and 'Start as a guest' actions

steps.expected: Safe incoming intent persists into guest sign-in

evidence.network: Role-selection navigation preserved redirectedFrom=/bookings into the guest sign-in route

assertions.title: Guest sign-in is passwordless, email-first, and guest-oriented

steps.expected: Guest sign-in asks only for email and uses magic-link copy
steps.observed: Form showed a single 'Email address' field, 'Send magic link' CTA, guest-oriented copy, and owner sign-in separated into a secondary link

evidence.network: Document request for /auth/signin rendered guest sign-in page

assertions.title: Guest sign-in surfaces inline validation, submission status, and cooldown feedback

steps.observed: No inline validation message appeared; button remained visible with same label

steps.action: Enter guest@example.com and trigger the send action
steps.expected: Visible submission or success/cooldown feedback appears
steps.observed: Button text and page state did not change, and no success/cooldown message became visible

evidence.network: No auth submission network request was captured during the attempted send flow

assertions.issues: Live sign-in surface did not show inline validation or visible submission/success/cooldown feedback.

assertions.title: Guest sign-in communicates trust and legal context

steps.expected: Trust/legal context is visible and guest-oriented
steps.observed: Page included reassuring guest copy, statistics, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links, and avoided raw provider/backend jargon

evidence.network: Terms and privacy links were rendered on the sign-in surface

assertions.title: Magic-link callback failures are translated into guest-safe messages

steps.expected: Guest-safe error message explains link failure
steps.observed: Rendered sign-in page showed no visible callback failure messaging; URL retained authError query only

evidence.network: Direct document request loaded the sign-in page with authError query but without guest-visible error feedback

assertions.issues: Callback failure query did not produce a visible guest-safe error message.

assertions.title: Sign-in returns guests to the intended destination

steps.action: Inspect sign-in entry with valid and invalid redirectedFrom values
steps.observed: Pre-auth URLs preserved valid guest intent and retained invalid external intent, but no usable live auth completion fixture was available without mutating shared authenticated state

evidence.network: Observed only pre-auth document requests; live auth completion was not exercised

assertions.issues: Blocked from safely proving post-auth return behavior because this validator was not allowed to mutate shared authenticated state and no dedicated mocked auth completion surface was provided.

assertions.title: Authenticated visits to /auth canonicalize to the correct signed-in destination

steps.action: Open /auth with guest redirect intent while unauthenticated
steps.expected: Authenticated users would be redirected to signed-in destination
steps.observed: Unauthenticated browser remained on /auth role-selection page

evidence.network: Only unauthenticated /auth document requests were observed; no authenticated redirect could be exercised

assertions.issues: Blocked because the assignment disallowed mutating shared authenticated state and no authenticated guest/owner browser fixture was available.

assertions.title: Root-host sign-in with app-owned intent hands off to app-host sign-in

steps.expected: Flow canonicalizes to app-host sign-in while preserving safe app intent

evidence.network: Document request chain included root-host /auth/signin?redirectedFrom=/app followed by app.localhost /auth/signin?redirectedFrom=%2Fapp

frictions.description: agent-browser element refs became stale after navigation, so repeated snapshots were needed before clicking role-selection links and sign-in controls.
frictions.resolution: Re-ran agent-browser snapshot -i after each navigation before interacting.

frictions.description: The sign-in form emitted no visible submission or callback-error feedback in live validation, making several auth assertions negative findings rather than positive confirmations.
frictions.resolution: Recorded the missing live feedback as assertion failures/blockers with screenshots.

blockers.description: No safe authenticated guest or owner browser fixture was provided, and the assignment explicitly prohibited mutating shared authenticated state.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Validated unauthenticated entry URLs and redirect-only behavior only; stopped short of creating a signed-in session.

knowledge: The live guest auth entry at /auth exposes distinct guest and owner actions.
Root-host /auth/signin with redirectedFrom=/app canonicalizes to app.localhost:3000/auth/signin while preserving the encoded app intent.
On this runtime, unsafe redirectedFrom=https://evil.example remains visible in the guest sign-in URL rather than being sanitized away before render.
On this runtime, /auth/signin?authError=invalid_or_expired renders without any visible guest-facing error banner or helper copy.
summary: Tested 10 assigned auth/redirect assertions on localhost:3000: 5 passed, 3 failed, and 2 were blocked by the no-authenticated-state constraint.
